title: I spent $100 on ChatGPT tokens to make me a bot I made back $800 within the month.
author: Extavius
selftext:
Can’t believe how magical it is, but it could just be a lucky month, ill update again with a seperate post in november!  
But ive already made back my initial capital of 500 usd

replies.body: The broker im using offers BTC/USD CFDs so apart from trading gold i can trade btc aswell

replies.author: Extavius
replies.body: I could spare the effort to do all the proving but its difficult to prove to a skeptic

replies.author: Gold_Digger_666
replies.body: I'm a real trader.  I post my account daily on x.  So, what strategy did you train the "Bot" on?  What API are you using to communicate with the trading platform?  What API to get your live data feed?

replies.author: Extavius
replies.body:
1. My original live trading strategy is a breakout based one where i Isolate the past 15 candles on m15 to make a virtual box to determine the highs and lows of the wicks, then set Buy stops at the high and Sell stops at the lows
2. No need for API with trading platform, the broker that i use offers CFDs for BTC/USD (XM Global)

, I use Metatrader 5 which allows us to Load bots easily

1. You are mistaken with the use of AI for this bot, I do not use it to make decisions

 per trade 

1. but rather use the AI to make a bot based on my manual trading rules and then coverting it into quantifiable measures.

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: One month on leveraged BTC CFDs is a coin flip, not a strategy, lol. The bot didn't make $800, the leverage did, and it'll take it back the first time BTC gaps against you.

replies.author: Extavius
replies.body:
For this , Ive a fixed SL at 5% per entry, for example a few hrs ago binance did tank the price of BTC, although I made money on the sell stop on the way down, had it gone against me, ive  
Configured it to only lose 5% of the balance

So… using tools to my advantage whether or not it works out ultimately is not a strategy? Everything should just be credited to leverage?
